# ZenScout AI — llms.txt
> ZenScout AI is an autonomous, multi-agent AI career acceleration platform engineered by Aneevarp Solutions. It automates the end-to-end job search process using specialized generative AI agents: real-time Google Jobs discovery, semantic PDF resume compatibility scoring, hyper-tailored cover letter generation, and real-time Voice AI mock interview coaching with a 100% Zero-Backend privacy guarantee.

## Platform Identity & Core Value
- **Platform Name:** ZenScout AI (by Aneevarp Solutions)
- **Primary Website:** https://ai-job-search-agent-chi.vercel.app
- **Companion Product:** ZenResume (https://zenresume.vercel.app / https://zenresume.online)
- **Operating Entity:** Aneevarp Solutions (Hyderabad, Telangana, India)
- **Core Architecture:** Zero-Backend Privacy Architecture (100% client-side local storage with ephemeral TLS AI streaming, no centralized candidate resume database).

---

## The 4 Specialized Autonomous Agents

1. **Agent Scout (Live Job Discovery):**
   - Integrates real-time Google Jobs & SerpApi feeds to scan 15+ job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Y Combinator, TechCareers).
   - Dynamically filters for experience level (Fresher / 0 Years, 1-3 Years, Mid-Level, Senior) and location/remote preferences.
   - Eliminates stale, duplicate, or sponsored spam listings.

2. **Agent Filter (Deep ATS Resume Compatibility Scoring):**
   - Directly parses candidate PDF resumes and compares them against live job descriptions using Gemini 2.5 Flash semantic embeddings.
   - Calculates a precise compatibility match score (0-100%) and categorizes candidates (Top Tier Match, Strong Alignment, Needs Tailoring).
   - Enforces strict experience calibration (penalizing senior requirements for 0-year candidates to prevent false matches).

3. **Agent Factory (Tailored Cover Letter & Application Materials):**
   - Extracts candidate real name, email, phone, and achievements directly from uploaded PDF resumes without placeholder templates.
   - Generates human-written, concise, high-converting 3-paragraph cover letters tailored to specific hiring managers.
   - Avoids robotic AI clichés (like "I am thrilled to apply", "delve into", "testament to").

4. **Agent Coach (Interactive Voice & Text Interview Simulator):**
   - Simulates a real hiring manager conducting technical, behavioral, and situational interviews tailored to the specific company and job description.
   - Supports real-time text and Voice AI interaction with progressive multi-turn questioning and instant constructive feedback.

---

## Free & Pro Value Ladder (Pricing)

- **Free Tier (₹0 / $0 forever):**
  - 5 Live Job Scans per day.
  - 2 Tailored Cover Letters per day.
  - 3 Mock Interview simulation turns per day.
  - Includes Google AdSense monetization.
- **1-Month Starter Pro (₹299 / $9.99):**
  - 25 Scans/day, 10 Cover Letters/day, 15 Interview rounds/day.
  - 100% Ad-Free interface with priority speed compute.
- **3-Month Career Pass (₹699 / $24.99) — Most Popular:**
  - Unlimited Job Scans, Unlimited Cover Letters, Unlimited Interview Rounds.
  - Deep ATS Keyword Gap Analysis & Salary Intelligence.
- **Annual Pro VIP (₹1,999 / $59.99):**
  - Full year unlimited access + VIP priority AI compute + Early access to auto-apply browser extensions.
